description: The TRANSFERS table contains information about patient transfers between different care units and wards within the hospital. It captures details such as the patient's previous and current locations (care unit and ward), the admission and discharge times associated with the transfer, the length of stay (LOS), and the source database. Each row represents a single transfer event.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each hospital admission.

columns.name: ICUSTAY_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each ICU stay.

columns.name: DBSOURCE
columns.description: The database source for the data, either 'carevue', 'metavision' or 'both'.

columns.name: EVENTTYPE
columns.description: Type of event, such as 'admit', 'transfer' or 'discharge'.

columns.name: PREV_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's previous care unit, e.g., 'TSICU', 'SICU', 'CCU'.

columns.name: CURR_CAREUNIT
columns.description: The patient's current care unit, e.g., 'NICU', 'MICU', 'CCU'.

columns.name: PREV_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's previous ward.

columns.name: CURR_WARDID
columns.description: Ward identifier for the patient's current ward.

columns.name: INTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was admitted.

columns.name: OUTTIME
columns.description: The date and time the patient was discharged.

columns.name: LOS
columns.description: The length of stay (LOS) in days.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in TRANSFERS references SUBJECT_ID (patient identifier) in PATIENTS
HADM_ID in TRANSFERS references HADM_ID (hospital admission identifier) in ADMISSIONS
ICUSTAY_ID in TRANSFERS references ICUSTAY_ID in ICUSTAYS
